title: Fix email verification flow — false success and signature mismatch
description: Two cooperating bugs cause the email verification flow to show a success screen but leave email_verified_at null in the DB. Bug 1 (frontend): { baseURL: '' } overrides the axios instance's baseURL, sending the request to the frontend origin instead of the API. Bug 2 (backend): temporarySignedRoute with absolute=false computes the HMAC from the relative URL, but hasValidSignature() validates against the absolute URL — mismatch causes 403.

stories.title: Fix frontend verifyEmail — remove { baseURL: '' } override
stories.description: Remove the per-request { baseURL: '' } override from verifyEmail() in auth.ts so the request routes through the axios instance's baseURL (same as all other API calls) instead of the frontend origin.
acceptanceCriteria: pontis-app/src/api/auth.ts: verifyEmail() no longer passes { baseURL: '' } as the second argument to client.get() — VERIFIED: edit applied, { baseURL: '' } removed
The path extraction logic (url.pathname + url.search) is preserved — VERIFIED: logic unchanged
client.get(path) is called with no second argument — VERIFIED
TypeScript compiles without errors — VERIFIED: tsc --noEmit exit code 0

stories.title: Fix backend VerifyEmailNotification — use absolute=true signed URL
stories.description: Remove the 'false' (absolute=false) argument from URL::temporarySignedRoute() and remove the redundant url() wrapper.
acceptanceCriteria: VerifyEmailNotification.php: temporarySignedRoute() called without 4th argument — VERIFIED: false argument removed
The url() wrapper around $apiUrl is removed — VERIFIED: urlencode($apiUrl) used directly
The returned URL still has format: {frontendUrl}/verify-email?verify_url={encodedApiUrl} — VERIFIED: format preserved
PHP syntax valid — VERIFIED: php -l reports no syntax errors
